annotations.title: Count a card payment with no statement as spending

description: The card payments in a bank statement for a card this document has no statement of — that month of card spending is otherwise missing. Without `cards`, lists them. With `cards` (the last four digits, or `unknown`), counts each card’s payments as the spending they stand for, so Home stops asking; the rows already count, so no figure moves. Reading the card’s statement later still makes them card payments to answer. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

cards.description: Last four digits per card, or `unknown`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
